abilities.text: Allies within 5 tiles gain +100% attack speed. Only the strongest aura applies. Reload, cooldowns and continuous damage/s are unchanged.

abilities.name: Damage Aura
abilities.text: Allies within 5 tiles gain +50% direct damage. Only the strongest Damage Aura applies; damage over time and other auras are unchanged.

abilities.name: Protection Aura
abilities.text: Allies within 4 tiles suffer 50% shorter Disarm and Dread. Only the strongest Protection Aura applies.

abilities.name: Visibility
abilities.text: Reveal hidden enemies within 6 tiles for all allies. This removes concealment, not evasion or damage immunity.

units.name: Archbishop
units.role: TOP Archbishop: Attack Speed Aura, Damage Aura, Protection Aura.

abilities.name: Attack Speed Aura
abilities.text: Allies within 5 tiles gain +500% attack speed. Only the strongest aura applies. Reload, cooldowns and continuous damage/s are unchanged.

abilities.name: Damage Aura
abilities.text: Allies within 5 tiles gain +100% direct damage. Only the strongest Damage Aura applies; damage over time and other auras are unchanged.

abilities.name: Protection Aura
abilities.text: Allies within 5 tiles suffer no Disarm and Dread effects. Only the strongest Protection Aura applies.

abilities.name: Visibility
abilities.text: Reveal hidden enemies within 6 tiles for all allies. This removes concealment, not evasion or damage immunity.

units.name: Paladin Oathbreaker
units.role: Advanced Paladin Oathbreaker: Freeze, Slow, Slow Aura.

abilities.name: Freeze
abilities.text: Hits have a 20% chance to Freeze the target for 2 s, stopping movement and attacks. Freeze-immune enemies are unaffected.

abilities.name: Slow
abilities.text: Hits slow movement by 25% for 3 s. Only the strongest Slow applies.

abilities.name: Slow Aura
abilities.text: Enemies within 4 tiles move 40% more slowly. Only the strongest movement Slow or Slow Aura applies.

units.name: Lady Claire
units.role: Secret Lady Claire: Lightning, Spark.

abilities.name: Lightning
abilities.text: Direct attacks have a 20% chance to chain lightning to 4 different enemies for 250 Magical damage each (Holy on Holy defenders). Jumps reach 4 tiles. A target is hit once per chain.

abilities.name: Spark
abilities.text: Every 5 s, strike one enemy in attack range for 1,500 Magical lightning damage.

abilities.name: Armor Penetration
abilities.text: Direct damage ignores 15% of positive enemy armor. This also applies to continuous direct damage; it does not reduce armor for allies or bypass immunity.

abilities.name: Critical Strike
abilities.text: Direct attacks have a 10% chance to deal ×5 damage. Burn, Poison and auras do not critically strike.

abilities.name: Ricochet
abilities.text: Each direct attack release has a 20% chance to ricochet from its first selected primary target to up to one additional distinct enemy, with each jump reaching up to 3 tiles. Each bounce retains 50% of the previous packet's damage, starting from the defender's unbuffed listed primary damage. The first bounce deals 50% of that base; bounce n deals base × 0.5^n. Roll once per release. Exclude every directly hit victim, never hit an enemy twice and never bounce back. Use the listed primary damage channel and direct target eligibility; normal defenses apply. Ricochet packets cannot critically strike, apply on-hit statuses, trigger abilities or carry Splash. The independent one-origin Splash/Cleave rule remains separate.

abilities.name: True Strike

abilities.name: Armor Penetration
abilities.text: Direct damage ignores 15% of positive enemy armor. This also applies to continuous direct damage; it does not reduce armor for allies or bypass immunity.

abilities.name: Critical Strike
abilities.text: Direct attacks have a 10% chance to deal ×5 damage. Burn, Poison and auras do not critically strike.

abilities.name: Ricochet
abilities.text: Each direct attack release has a 20% chance to ricochet from its first selected primary target to up to one additional distinct enemy, with each jump reaching up to 3 tiles. Each bounce retains 50% of the previous packet's damage, starting from the defender's unbuffed listed primary damage. The first bounce deals 50% of that base; bounce n deals base × 0.5^n. Roll once per release. Exclude every directly hit victim, never hit an enemy twice and never bounce back. Use the listed primary damage channel and direct target eligibility; normal defenses apply. Ricochet packets cannot critically strike, apply on-hit statuses, trigger abilities or carry Splash. The independent one-origin Splash/Cleave rule remains separate.

abilities.name: True Strike
abilities.text: Direct attacks ignore 40% of enemy evasion. Armor and immunity remain active.

abilities.name: Ricochet
abilities.text: Each direct attack release has a 40% chance to ricochet from its first selected primary target to up to 3 additional distinct enemies, with each jump reaching up to 3 tiles. Each bounce retains 70% of the previous packet's damage, starting from the defender's unbuffed listed primary damage. The first bounce deals 70% of that base; bounce n deals base × 0.7^n. Roll once per release. Exclude every directly hit victim, never hit an enemy twice and never bounce back. Use the listed primary damage channel and direct target eligibility; normal defenses apply. Ricochet packets cannot critically strike, apply on-hit statuses, trigger abilities or carry Splash. The independent one-origin Splash/Cleave rule remains separate.
